scope: Only MCP witness projection, context revision binding, archived receipt tests, local starter/HTTP smoke and collector evidence checks. Prior full runtime review remains separate.

closed_findings.trigger: python -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE removes assertion-only HTTP acceptance checks
closed_findings.original_effect: Offline fake HTTP with anonymous/forged=200, mismatched run, EVT stage and approved receipt still wrote evidence and exited zero.
closed_findings.fix: All smoke acceptance checks now use explicit if/SystemExit; collector uses explicit if/RuntimeError.

fresh_verification.driver: OFFLINE_FAKE_HTTP; fake task token only; no actual HTTP/identity access

closed_findings.trigger: Valid self-hashed transcript with response preceding request, unsolicited response, or invalid JSON-RPC request/response/notification field combinations
closed_findings.original_effect: Helper could still label malformed witness RECORDED. No Gate or tool permission escalation was found.
closed_findings.fix: Responses must match a previously sent unanswered request; notification/request/response fields are mutually constrained; final response-ID set exactly matches three request IDs.

script_boundary_review: Starter binds the existing DEV API only on fixed loopback 8769; does not stop another listening process and failure terminates only its own spawned child.
Starter requires task-owned runtime directory; log/PID opens use O_NOFOLLOW and requested mode0600.
HTTP smoke uses fixed loopback, trust_env=False, read-only GETs, generated local identity and no model or business dispatch.

Collector verifies current source-authorized persistent snapshots, output and audit hashes, fixed model metadata and pending business authority with explicit checks; semantic quality remains NOT_FULLY_ACCEPTED.
New evidence paths refuse existing target paths; old reports and the first full review are not overwritten.
limits: RECORDED means validated transcript activity; it does not prove sandbox safety, hardware certification, a successful Gate or human approval.
Actual Root-owned three-case model traces and PostgreSQL/Docker checks are separate evidence; this reviewer did not run inference, Docker or a PostgreSQL live probe.
Root reported PASS analysis COMPLETE and blocked/unknown analyses INCOMPLETE with four valid calls each; this report does not independently claim full semantic acceptance.
Observed unsupported PASS claim Unknown evidence status remains a model quality failure; schema/citation validity does not prove claim correctness.
No SRE, embedding, external API/write, production or arbitrary generated-code scope is added by this review.
